title: MMIR Progress Dashboard
principle: Free-first, local-first, zero-trust: ship useful defaults before paid or complex infrastructure.
current_focus: Keep first chat useful without setup.
Make local install and model activation one-click where possible.
Keep paid/provider/cloud paths blocked until cost policy is explicit.
Use the sequential backlog as source of truth for all Codex work.

status_legend.done: Shipped and guarded by local or CI checks for the current scope.
status_legend.beta: Usable foundation exists; keep improving before calling it complete.
status_legend.next: Next implementation slice for Codex work.
status_legend.watch: Needs external verification, network availability or follow-up monitoring.
status_legend.blocked: Blocked until user validation, cost approval or prerequisite architecture is ready.
status_legend.planned: Planned after higher-priority activation, security and architecture work.

activation_simulator.title: MMIR Activation Simulator
activation_simulator.principle: Free-first activation must always land on one useful next action without provider secrets, raw prompts, paid routes or public runtime exposure.
activation_simulator.public_repo_rule: Fixtures are public-safe state labels only. They do not contain provider keys, pairing tokens, raw prompts, raw responses, billing data or private user content.

scenarios.label: First visit gets a free answer path
scenarios.user_goal: Land on MMIR and get immediate value before installing anything.
scenarios.simulated_signal: No backend profile, no local node, no first-chat receipt.
scenarios.expected_next_action: Use the free browser guide or start a local install only when needed.

scenarios.label: Missing connector maps to one device repair
scenarios.user_goal: Understand exactly what to install on this device.
scenarios.simulated_signal: Local node is unreachable on localhost.
scenarios.expected_next_action: Show one OS/device-specific connector repair card.

scenarios.label: Installer return resumes verification
scenarios.user_goal: Return from installer and have MMIR continue automatically.
scenarios.simulated_signal: mmir_local_return=1 and stored repair resume state.
scenarios.expected_next_action: Refresh connector, model discovery, proof and repair resume status.

scenarios.label: Connector online asks for one free model
scenarios.user_goal: Install a model that fits the current device without terminal work.
scenarios.simulated_signal: Connector is reachable, runtime exists, model count is zero.
scenarios.expected_next_action: Open model library with an installable free starter model.
